# Generated by gen_p04.py - do not edit by hand.
source React 19.3.1 on jsdom 30.1.3 for the dumps; the unit formula (1 root fiber + elements + text nodes) for the idle lines
seed 1
compare records idle=units dump=n node=depth,label,tag,props text=depth,value title=value
explain node:props=R6 text:value=R6
requirement R1 render only schedules the work: right after it the container is still empty and no unit has run
requirement R2 one unit of work per fiber: the root fiber, every element and every text node, and nothing else
requirement R3 the loop reads timeRemaining() once after each unit: idle k reports min(k, units left)
requirement R4 the walk reaches every fiber, depth first (child, then sibling, then the parent's sibling and so on up), so after flush the container holds the whole tree in order
requirement R5 with no work left a period reads nothing and reports 0: before any render and after the tree is done
requirement R6 every node carries the props and the text of its element
requirement E2E whole scenarios: empty page, uneven periods, finished page
